stakeholders.name: Bauchi State Ministry of Solid Minerals Development
stakeholders.description: Develop, regulate and manage Bauchi State’s solid mineral resources, including policy, investment promotion and sector governance.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: State-level policy, regulation and investment coordination for minerals.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: All solid mineral activities within Bauchi State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Designs and implements solid minerals policy; supervises mining and quarrying; promotes investment and reforms; coordinates with federal agencies and communities.

stakeholders.name: Ministry of Lands, Survey and Solid Minerals
stakeholders.description: Oversee land administration, surveying and regulation of the solid minerals sector in Benue State.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Sector coordination, regulation and land/tenure support for mining.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Land and mineral activities in Benue State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Allocates land for mining; regulates operations; supports sector planning and coordination; liaises with federal regulators and investors.

stakeholders.name: Cross River State Ministry of Solid Minerals Development
stakeholders.description: Manage, regulate and promote sustainable development of Cross River State’s mineral resources.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: State-level policy, regulation and minerals sector governance.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Solid mineral operations within Cross River State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Develops policies and regulations; supervises operators; supports investment promotion; coordinates environmental and regulatory compliance.

stakeholders.name: Ebonyi State Ministry of Solid Minerals Development
stakeholders.description: Administer, regulate and develop Ebonyi State’s solid mineral resources.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Regulation, sector planning and mineral development promotion.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Solid mineral activities within Ebonyi State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Oversees mining and quarrying; manages state mineral agreements; promotes responsible exploitation; engages communities and investors.

stakeholders.name: Office of Solid Mineral Resources, Ekiti State
stakeholders.description: Coordinate the development and regulation of Ekiti State’s solid mineral resources.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Sector planning, investment facilitation and basic oversight.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Solid mineral activities within Ekiti State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Identifies mineral occurrences; supports investors; coordinates with federal agencies; advises government on mineral-led development.

stakeholders.name: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Solid Minerals
stakeholders.description: Drive industrial development and regulate solid mineral activities in Jigawa State.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Investment promotion and mineral value-chain development.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Commerce, industry and solid mineral activities in Jigawa State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Promotes mineral-linked industrial projects; supports investors; facilitates SME and value-chain development; coordinates compliance.

stakeholders.name: Kano State Ministry of Solid Minerals Resources
stakeholders.description: Manage and promote sustainable development of Kano State’s mineral resources.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: State-level regulation and mineral sector economic planning.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Solid mineral resources in Kano State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Maps opportunities; supervises operations; supports mineral-based SMEs; aligns mineral development with state economic goals.

stakeholders.name: Kaduna State Ministry of Solid Minerals
stakeholders.description: Develop and implement mineral sector policy and support mineral-led economic activities in Kaduna State.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Solid mineral activities in Kaduna State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Coordinates licensing inputs; oversees mining activities; promotes value addition; engages communities and local government.

stakeholders.name: Ministry of Solid Minerals Development and Mining
stakeholders.description: Oversee solid mineral development and mining activities in Kebbi State.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Regulation and investment facilitation across exploration and mining.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Mineral development and mining operations in Kebbi State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Supervises mines and quarries; supports investors; coordinates environmental and regulatory compliance; promotes responsible mineral exploitation.

stakeholders.name: Kogi State Ministry of Solid Minerals and Natural Resources
stakeholders.description: Manage and develop Kogi State’s solid minerals and natural resources, including mapping and reserve estimation.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Resource assessment, sector planning and project facilitation.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Solid mineral operations in Kogi State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Conducts mapping and studies; guides mineral project development; supports investors; works with communities and federal regulators.

stakeholders.name: Kwara State Commission for Solid Minerals Development
stakeholders.description: Promote, develop and manage the solid minerals sector in Kwara State.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Sector development, exploration support and investment promotion.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Solid mineral development across Kwara State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Identifies mineral opportunities; promotes investment; coordinates PPPs; supports local communities and state-backed mineral projects.

stakeholders.name: Ogun State Mineral Resources Development Agency
stakeholders.description: Manage and develop Ogun State’s mineral resources and ensure responsible mining.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Resource management, data generation and oversight.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Mineral resources and operations in Ogun State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Conducts geological surveys; maintains mineral data bank; supports responsible mining; coordinates with communities for inclusive development.

stakeholders.name: Bureau for Solid Minerals, Taraba State
stakeholders.description: Regulate, promote and support exploration and sustainable development of Taraba State’s solid minerals.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Regulation, exploration oversight and sustainable development planning.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Solid mineral activities in Taraba State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Issues permits; supports exploration programmes; coordinates safeguards; promotes investment aligned with state priorities.

stakeholders.name: Niger State Ministry of Mineral Resources
stakeholders.description: Manage the mineral sector in Niger State, tackle illegal mining and support investment attraction.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Mineral resources and mining activities in Niger State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Profiles miners; combats illegal mining; coordinates strategies to attract investors; collaborates with security agencies and federal regulators.

stakeholders.name: Nasarawa Investment & Development Agency (NASIDA)
stakeholders.description: Facilitate and coordinate investments in Nasarawa State, including PPPs and commercialisation of mineral assets.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Investment projects and PPPs in Nasarawa State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Structures PPPs; markets investment opportunities; coordinates approvals; supports investors; commercialises mineral-linked state assets.

stakeholders.name: Zamfara State Ministry of Environment, Mines & Solid Minerals
stakeholders.description: Regulate environmental protection and solid mineral development in Zamfara State.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Environmental governance, minerals oversight and compliance.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Environment, mines and solid minerals in Zamfara State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Supervises mining with focus on environment and public health; coordinates remediation; supports formalisation and safer mining practices.

stakeholders.name: Office of Mineral Resources, Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources
stakeholders.description: Manage Lagos State’s energy and mineral resources and enforce environmental/resource standards.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Energy and minerals policy, regulation and environmental oversight.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Energy and mineral activities in Lagos State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Plans and regulates energy and mineral resource use; enforces standards; coordinates with federal agencies; promotes sustainable mineral and energy projects.

stakeholders.name: Oyo State Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources
stakeholders.description: Responsible for formulating, coordinating and implementing policies on energy and mineral resources in Oyo State, including the development, regulation and sustainable management of mineral assets and energy resources.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Energy and minerals sector policy, regulation, investment facilitation and environmental oversight.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Energy and solid mineral activities within Oyo State
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Develops and enforces state policies on energy and mineral resource management; supervises mining and quarrying operations; coordinates with federal agencies on licensing and compliance; supports investment in mineral and energy projects; ensures environmental and community safeguards; promotes sustainable resource exploitation to enhance state economic development.
